title: params/<system_id>/<parameter>.yaml
description: One parameter per file: meta describes the quantity, data maps a label (Q000, M00, Q000-Q001) to its value. measurement_defaults.yaml is a settings file and is not validated by this schema.

data.description: Label (Q000, M00, Q000-Q001; MUX files may use the MUX number) to value.
